newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber unchanged in noon trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber unchanged in noon trading.

text.p: Indonesian SIR20 rubber offer prices were unchanged in noon trading on Tuesday with market sentiment remaining weak due to sluggish demand, traders said.
"Market sentiment remains weak despite the news that the strike at U.S. tyre-maker Goodyear has ended," said one trader.
"It is the continued sluggish demand which has become our prime concern," he added.
Trader said offer prices were unchanged at 47.25 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan, 46.50 fob Padang, 46.75 fob Surabaya and 46.25 fob Jambi and Pontianak.
Traders said they did not expect prices to pick up later on Tuesday as supply remained largely sufficient in the local market.
